module.name: Bookshelf
module.author: Demo
module.description: A personal bookshelf and reading tracker demo showcasing the Jinja2 database template system (render_db_template). Browse books as styled spines on wooden shelves with ratings, reading status, filtering, and stats.

scripts.script:
from app.models import Template books_model = DynamicModel.get_or_create('bookshelf_books', { 'title': db.String(200), 'author': db.String(150), 'genre': db.String(80), 'status': db.String(20), 'rating': db.Integer, 'notes': db.Text, 'cover_color': db.String(7), 'pages': db.Integer, 'year': db.Integer, 'created_at': db.DateTime, }) existing_count = session.query(books_model).count() if existing_count == 0: seed_books = [ {'title': 'Dune', 'author': 'Frank Herbert', 'genre': 'Sci-Fi', 'status': 'completed', 'rating': 5, 'notes': 'A masterpiece of world-building. The spice must flow.', 'cover_color': '#c9a959', 'pages': 688, 'year': 1965}, {'title': 'The Great Gatsby', 'author': 'F. Scott Fitzgerald', 'genre': 'Classic', 'status': 'completed', 'rating': 4, 'notes': 'Beautiful prose, tragic characters. An American classic.', 'cover_color': '#1a6b3c', 'pages': 180, 'year': 1925}, {'title': 'Neuromancer', 'author': 'William Gibson', 'genre': 'Sci-Fi', 'status': 'completed', 'rating': 4, 'notes': 'Cyberpunk origin story. Case jacked into the matrix.', 'cover_color': '#2d2d2d', 'pages': 271, 'year': 1984}, {'title': 'Pride and Prejudice', 'author': 'Jane Austen', 'genre': 'Romance', 'status': 'completed', 'rating': 5, 'notes': 'Wit, romance, and social commentary. Absolutely timeless.', 'cover_color': '#c4547a', 'pages': 432, 'year': 1813}, {'title': 'The Hobbit', 'author': 'J.R.R. Tolkien', 'genre': 'Fantasy', 'status': 'reading', 'rating': 0, 'notes': 'Re-reading for the fifth time. Still magical.', 'cover_color': '#2e7d32', 'pages': 310, 'year': 1937}, {'title': '1984', 'author': 'George Orwell', 'genre': 'Dystopian', 'status': 'completed', 'rating': 5, 'notes': 'Chillingly relevant. Big Brother is watching.', 'cover_color': '#b71c1c', 'pages': 328, 'year': 1949}, {'title': 'Sapiens', 'author': 'Yuval Noah Harari', 'genre': 'Non-Fiction', 'status': 'reading', 'rating': 0, 'notes': 'Fascinating look at human history. Halfway through.', 'cover_color': '#e65100', 'pages': 443, 'year': 2011}, {'title': 'The Name of the Wind', 'author': 'Patrick Rothfuss', 'genre': 'Fantasy', 'status': 'completed', 'rating': 4, 'notes': 'Kvothe tells his tale. Beautiful language and magic system.', 'cover_color': '#4a148c', 'pages': 662, 'year': 2007}, {'title': 'Atomic Habits', 'author': 'James Clear', 'genre': 'Self-Help', 'status': 'unread', 'rating': 0, 'notes': 'Next on the list. Heard great things about habit stacking.', 'cover_color': '#0277bd', 'pages': 320, 'year': 2018}, {'title': 'The Martian', 'author': 'Andy Weir', 'genre': 'Sci-Fi', 'status': 'unread', 'rating': 0, 'notes': 'Bought it on sale. Space survival sounds fun.', 'cover_color': '#bf360c', 'pages': 369, 'year': 2011}, ] for b in seed_books: book = books_model( title=b['title'], author=b['author'], genre=b['genre'], status=b['status'], rating=b['rating'], notes=b['notes'], cover_color=b['cover_color'], pages=b['pages'], year=b['year'], created_at=datetime.now(timezone.utc), ) session.add(book) session.commit() status_filter = request.args.get('status', '').strip() if status_filter in ('reading', 'completed', 'unread'): all_books = books_model.query.filter_by(status=status_filter).order_by(books_model.title).all() else: all_books = books_model.query.order_by(books_model.title).all() status_filter = '' all_count = books_model.query.count() completed_count = books_model.query.filter_by(status='completed').count() reading_list = books_model.query.filter_by(status='reading').all() unread_count = books_model.query.filter_by(status='unread').count() rated_books = books_model.query.filter(books_model.rating > 0).all() avg_rating = sum(b.rating for b in rated_books) / len(rated_books) if rated_books else 0 stats = { 'total': all_count, 'completed': completed_count, 'reading': len(reading_list), 'unread': unread_count, 'avg_rating': round(avg_rating, 1), } tpl = Template.query.filter_by(name='book_shelf', module_id=module_id).first() if tpl: _result = render_db_template(tpl.body, books=all_books, stats=stats, filter_status=status_filter) else: _result = '

Bookshelf

Template not found. Please re-import the Bookshelf module.

'
